title: Take a picture of part of my screen
summary: Use the Snipping Tool to capture part of your screen and paste it into an email.
bonus_tip: A faster way for next time: press the Windows key, Shift, and S together to start a new picture.

steps.text: Click the Start button: the four blue squares at the bottom of your screen.
steps.alt: Drawing of a Windows screen with an email open. The Start button, four blue squares in the bar at the bottom, has an orange outline.

steps.text: Click the New button near the top left of the Snipping Tool window.

steps.text: Hold the mouse button down and drag a box around the part you want.
steps.alt: Drawing of a darkened screen. The mouse drags from one corner to the other, drawing a clear box over the part of the screen to keep.

steps.text: Let go of the mouse button to take the picture.
steps.alt: Drawing of a Windows screen. A message in the bottom right corner says the picture was copied, and has an orange outline.

steps.text: Press the button on the right side of your mouse.
